ambient_events: A hull moves against the fenders somewhere above you and the whole column of water shifts.
Rust comes off the quay wall in flakes the size of playing cards and goes down slowly.
Chain runs out overhead, a long way overhead, and stops.
Something the size of a door goes past underneath, unhurried.
description: Deep water in the shadow of the gantries. The quay wall stands WEST, its fenders hanging down the face on chains thick enough to moor a house, and the booms come out over your head far enough that you are standing under one of them. There is a ship alongside often enough that the water here never really settles.
name: Basin Quay Berth
